label: Organic Light
description: Natural and practical light sources with soft, believable falloff — the intimate end of the lighting spectrum.

items.name: window-light
items.text: soft directional daylight from a single large window, gentle falloff into shadow across the room, dust visible in the beam

items.name: sheer-curtain-glow
items.text: daylight diffused through sheer curtains, wrapping soft light with barely defined shadows, the window turned into one glowing panel

items.name: blinds-slats
items.text: low sun slicing through venetian blinds, parallel bands of warm light raking across skin and wall, stripes bending over every curve

items.name: candlelight
items.text: flickering candlelight glowing deep amber, steep intimate falloff pulling faces bright out of soft darkness, highlights trembling

items.name: fireplace-glow
items.text: firelight from an open hearth, warm flickering key from below, deep shadow behind and light that never sits still
items.text_short: firelight from an open hearth, flickering warm key

items.name: string-lights
items.text: warm fairy string lights, small soft points of glow close to the subject and creamy bokeh circles in the background depth

items.name: bedside-lamp
items.text: a single warm bedside lamp, cozy low-key pool of light with soft shadow edges fading into the dim room

items.name: golden-hour-window
items.text: late golden-hour sun pouring horizontally through a window, long warm shadows thrown deep into the room and glowing edges on everything it touches

items.name: overcast-softbox
items.text: bright overcast sky acting as one huge softbox, shadowless even light with true colors

items.name: dappled-leaves
items.text: sunlight dappled through foliage, shifting spots of light and leaf-shadow patterns sliding over the subject

items.name: campfire-circle
items.text: a campfire as the only source, orange light flickering up from below waist height, faces modeled warm against the surrounding dark and sparks lifting on the heat column

items.name: screen-glow
items.text: the cool blue-white flicker of a screen lighting the face from just below eye line, a soft rectangular key in a dark room, its color shifting with the unseen picture

items.name: north-window
items.text: steady north-facing window light, the painter's source — cool, soft yet firmly directional, modeling form in long unchanging gradients that flatter skin and still life alike
